incident-bot: Incident RWINF-504 resolved at 2025-11-02T21:03Z — summary & links: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RWINF-504, doc: https://docs.redwood.com/incidents/RWINF-504 :white_check_mark:
Jamal R.: I think we should schedule a retrospective for RWINF-504. Impact crossed multiple regions and the rollback path wasn't clearly owned. Can folks share availability? Prefer next Tue/Wed morning PST.
Sophia L.: I can facilitate if no one objects. I have a flight Thurs, so Tue morning PST works best for me. @Jamal R. do you have the incident timeline to add as pre-read?
Miguel C.: +1 for Tue. I can pull the k8s logs and attach key traces. Also add my notes on the autoscaler config that bit us.
Tara N.: Tue works for me (Europe TZ) if we do it later in PST (like 11:00 PST) so it's not too late for EU folks.
Lee: 11:00 PST is fine. Could we try to keep it 45m? Need timebound agenda.
Jamal R.: Great. Agenda proposal:```- 5m quick context and impact (owner: Jamal)
- 10m timeline + key telemetry (owner: Miguel)
- 15m root cause discussion (facilitator: Sophia)
- 10m action items + owners
- 5m wrap & follow-up plan```
Jamal R.: Also, action: set up calendar invite + Zoom and add recording note (owner?).
Sophia L.: I can create the invite + add the doc and pre-read. I'll set recording on.
oncall-bot: @Sophia L. created event "RWINF-504 Retrospect" for 2025-11-11 11:00 PST — invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, product.ics attached.
Miguel C.: putting together a short dump of the autoscaler metrics, will paste into the doc by EOD.
Tara N.: Can someone capture customer-facing impact summary? I need that for the compliance ticket.
Jamal R.: I will draft the impact blurb (customers affected, ETA for retries, mitigation timeline) and add it to pre-read.
Sophia L.: Quick ask — can we have at least one person who owned the rollback playbook in the room? @Lee can you confirm?
Lee: I ran the rollback yesterday. I'll join and give a 2-min walkthrough of steps and gaps.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: RWINF-504 pre-read due in 48h.
Miguel C.: noted. attaching logs snippet here for quick look:```kubectl logs -n rwinf svc-proxy | grep -i timeout | tail -n 40```
Tara N.: FYI I've added a calendar attendee from the support rotation so we can cover customer comms.
Sophia L.: ok final checklist before we close scheduling: 1) facilitator assigned (Sophia) 2) invite created + recording (done) 3) pre-read doc link in event (done) 4) owner for impact blurb (Jamal) 5) person to own action tracker (who wants it?)
Lee: I can own the action tracker after the meeting — will keep it in the incident doc and add status updates weekly.
Jamal R.: awesome. Can folks drop any immediate action items they want tracked in the doc? I'll consolidate.
Miguel C.: initial action: add an autoscaler probe to detect stuck scaling (owner: Miguel, ETA: 2 weeks).
Tara N.: add a runbook update for rollback verification steps (owner: Tara, ETA: 1 week).
Sophia L.: I'll draft facilitator notes template and post it in the doc.
incident-bot: Thread reminder: RWINF-504 Retrospect in 3 days — recording enabled.
Jamal R.: Thanks everyone. See you Tue 11:00 PST. If anything urgent comes up ping @oncall-bot or me. :thumbsup:
